# Hamid Kamal — Developer & Founder

> Summary for **Hamid Kamal** (also known as **Hamid**), 17-year-old AI Developer, Full Stack Software Engineer, and Founder based in Hyderabad, India.

## Overview
- **Name**: Hamid Kamal
- **Roles**: AI Developer, Full Stack Engineer, Founder, CTO at Learn Quran
- **Core Focus**: Full-stack web applications (React, TypeScript, Next.js), browser-hardware integrations (Web Serial API, Rust WASM), and applied machine learning (computer vision, RAG pipelines).
- **Website**: https://hamid-ai-dev.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/hamid220-kamal
- **LinkedIn**: https://linkedin.com/in/hamid-kamal
- **Email**: buildwithhamid@gmail.com
- **Credentials**: 29 verified industry certifications (Google Cloud, Oracle OCI 93%, IBM, HackerRank, Anthropic, AWS simulation).

## Key Projects & Ventures
- **Design Swiftly (CNC CAD/CAM Engine)**: Browser-based CAD/CAM manufacturing tool with 92,000+ lines of code in Rust, WASM, and TypeScript. Directly controls CNC hardware through the Web Serial API.
- **Learn Quran**: EdTech platform with low-latency audio communication connecting teachers and students globally.
- **AI Traffic Management System**: Computer vision application using YOLOv8 for vehicle detection and urban traffic analytics.
- **Multi-Agent AI System**: Python asyncio multi-agent orchestration framework with Pydantic v2 and ChromaDB vector persistence.
- **Production RAG System**: Hybrid dense + BM25 vector search with cross-encoder reranking and citation grounding.

## Tech Stack
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, C/C++, SQL
- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js, Web Serial API, WebSockets, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **AI & ML**: PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, LangChain, RAG, Claude AI, Gemini API
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Oracle Cloud (OCI Certified), Google Cloud, Docker, Git, Linux
- **Hardware**: Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, GRBL CNC Controllers
